partitions.development: historical known examples and new development fixtures
partitions.locked_evaluation: distinct transformation families frozen before first locked execution; no claim of blind repository selection or independent human authorship

rule: A crash is an error, not a detection. No eligible examples and missing required evidence are not_evaluated. Verify every counted source fault manifests against a separate reference oracle. Convention alternatives are sensitivities, not faults. Report every excluded mutation and every first execution.
scope: five existing repositories; evidence and controlled behavior; no model training
uncertainty: exact finite challenge outcomes and full-data census/bounds; no population accuracy intervals over handcrafted mutants
